description_expanded: ABOUT SUMMER WIND: Summer Wind is a luxurious retreat nestled in the heart of Seagrove, just steps away from the sugar-white beaches of the Emerald Coast and less than a mile from the picturesque town of Seaside. Accommodating up to 36 guests with 6 King Beds, this exquisite 7-bedrooms 7 Full Bathrooms and 2 half Bathrooms. This home offers ample space for both family and friends to relax and unwind. 1 minute walk to Dothan Beach Access with very small crowds all year round. Heated Pool and Jacuzzi Spa. Parking for 5 vehicles. Complimentary amenities include a 6-seater golf cart and 6 bicycles for easy exploration of the surrounding towns. Spanning nearly 6,000 square feet of heated and cooled living space, this grand beach home comprises four stories, with each of the first three levels featuring expansive open-concept common areas and spacious outdoor porches that offer breathtaking Gulf views on the upper levels. The gourmet kitchen and living room epitomize the ultimate vacation experience, boasting top-of-the-line appliances and generous seating to make you the perfect host. Summer Wind is further enhanced by an elevator, oversized porch spaces on each level, including a spectacular sun deck on the fourth floor with cypress trusses, an expansive pool and hot tub area at the front of the house illuminated by lights and a custom waterfall feature, an outdoor grill space, and enclosed by a brick and masonry fence that complements the exterior. With its prime location, upscale finishes, essential facilities, and abundant space for every member of the family, Summer Wind promises a stay that will make you reluctant to depart. Secure your dream vacation escape here today! Bedroom Breakdown: Second Floor - King Master Bedroom- Sleeps 2 Third Floor - Guest Bedroom with King Over 2 Full Bunks. Sleeps 6 - Guest Bedroom with King Over 2 Full Bunks. Sleeps 6 - Second King Master Bedroom- Sleeps 2 Fourth Floor - King Guest Bedroom- Sleeps 2 - King Guest Bedroom- Sleeps 2 - Bunk Room- Sleeps 16 ABOUT THE AREA: Seagrove Beach is a charming coastal community situated along Scenic Highway 30A in the Florida Panhandle. Known for its natural beauty, serene atmosphere, and pristine beaches, Seagrove Beach offers a perfect blend of relaxation and outdoor activities. One of the defining features of Seagrove Beach is its abundance of lush greenery, including scrub oaks, magnolias, and pines, creating a picturesque backdrop for beachfront living. The area is dotted with coastal dune lakes, rare geographical formations where fresh and saltwater meet, providing unique ecosystems for exploration. Visitors to Seagrove Beach can enjoy a wide range of outdoor activities, including swimming, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing in the crystal-clear waters of the Gulf of Mexico. The nearby Point Washington State Forest offers hiking and biking trails for nature enthusiasts, while golfers can tee off at world-class courses just a short drive away. Seagrove Beach is also home to an array of charming boutiques, art galleries, and restaurants serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. The community is known for its laid-back vibe and friendly locals, making it a welcoming destination for families, couples, and solo travelers alike. With its natural beauty, tranquil ambiance, and proximity to other popular beach communities along 30A, Seagrove Beach is a hidden gem waiting to be explored and enjoyed by all who appreciate the beauty of coastal living. BEACH ACCESS: * Santa Clara Regional Beach Access | 3345 E County Hwy 30A. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Pool & Spa * Pool Heat Included from Sept. 30th - May 31st * 6 Bikes included * 6 Seater Golf Cart included * Beach Access across the street PARKING: * Free Parking up to 5 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Additional $1000.00 refundable security deposit charged at confirmation. * Must Be 25 Years or Older * No pets allowed * No smoking allowed * All reservations are non-refundable and we strongly encourage adding travel insurance to your reservation so that you are covered. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
